label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson Lead
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 18-under par, five shots ahead of Sungjae Im, Kensei Hirata, Scottie Scheffler, and Wyndham Clark at 13-under.

items.headline: Im’s Ace and Eagle
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th hole and eagled the par-5 9th to shoot 61 and share the 36-hole lead at 13-under with Kensei Hirata.

items.headline: Scheffler, Spieth Skip Schwab
items.text: Jordan Spieth and World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler both chose to skip the Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial for the first time in Spieth's career.
